candidates.description: This feature vector activates on concepts related to constitutional governance, civil liberties, and democratic rights.
This vector represents sociopolitical upheaval, public unrest, and systemic instability.
This vector represents the concept of political uprisings, rebellions, and systemic revolutions.
This feature vector represents the concept of control, limitation, and regulatory constraints.
This feature activates on terms related to destabilization, disruption, and the damaging or weakening of systems, structures, or stability.
This vector represents adverbs and adjectives expressing frequency, habituality, and general occurrence.
This vector represents armed conflict, warfare, and hostile military or strategic engagement.
These tokens represent legal, administrative, or disciplinary actions and penalties taken against individuals or entities.
This feature vector represents verbs and related terms concerning verbal debate, argumentation, and contention.
This feature activates for words related to the termination, eradication, or undoing of systems, laws, or entities.
